tenures.note: Dated from the GCW cards that bill this team in a match as served here (1 bout on 1 card), the first to the last; GCW's April 2002 house-show report gives an earlier debut with no date of its own; no card in the fed's own database carries this name, so earlier or later cards are not dated here.

caption: The Solid Stones, a tag team of Bruce Stone and Wrigley Stone, wrestled one billed match for GCW, on Meltdown 54 on 11 April 2002; GCW's house-show report of April 2002 gives their debut, a win over the Paramedics.
